capabilities: visualize a note's Smart Connections as a force-directed graph
adjust layout forces, node size, label size, and link thickness
filter displayed connections by minimum relevance score
switch between note-level and block-level connections
preview notes or blocks on hover while navigating the graph
disambiguation: Despite the name, it visualizes connections for a single note at a time, not the whole vault; vault-wide clusters need the separate Smart Connections Vault Visualizer plugin.
extras: The README links to a demo video and includes a long 'Vision' section about the author's AI-related goals; the author solicits financial support for continued development.
intentEvidence: This plugin integrates seamlessly with the Smart Connections tool
motivation: The author struggles with maintaining a strict note-taking structure and wants to move from text-based organization toward visualizing information in a dynamic, context-driven state.
problem: Smart Connections presents related notes as text lists, with no visual way to explore how connections relate to the currently viewed note or how relevant they are.

relations.evidence: Ensure you have the Smart Connections plugin installed and all set up in your Obsidian environment.

summary: Force-directed graph view that visualizes the Smart Connections links of the current note, with relevance-based distances and adjustable layout forces.
